- Invoice indicators present: "RECHNUNG" header, "Rechnungsdatum", invoice numbers, line items, "Mehrwertsteuer", totals, payment terms. 
- No exclusion indicators ("Zahlungserinnerung"/"Mahnung"/"Servicebericht") prominent. 
=> Document classified as an invoice; proceed to extraction.

2) Identify candidate fields in text
- Grand total / Endbetrag: "Endbetrag: 1.526,49 EUR" — candidate GrandTotal.Amount = 1,526.49
- Dates: two date labels present:
  - "Ausstellungsdatum 14.11.2023"
  - "Rechnungsdatum 15.11.2023"
  Per schema "Invoice.Date" = Issue date of the invoice; the labeled "Rechnungsdatum" is typically invoice date. Choose "15.11.2023" (no inference beyond label).
- Sender VAT: bottom shows "UID ATU26011605" (also "Ihre Ust-Nr. ATU22642807" which is customer's VAT). For sender VAT use "ATU26011605".
- VAT group info: "Mehrwertsteuer: A 10,00% MwSt. auf 1.387,72 EUR 138,77 EUR"
  - Vat.Rate: 10,00% → extract as number without "%" and preserving decimals -> 10.00
  - Net.Amount: 1.387,72 EUR -> 1387.72 (preserve two decimals)
  - Vat.Amount: 138,77 EUR -> 138.77 (preserve two decimals)

3) No-inference & ambiguity handling
- Chose "Rechnungsdatum 15.11.2023" because label matches invoice date; did not infer or synthesize any other date.
- For sender VAT selected the "UID ATU26011605" explicitly labeled near company info; did not use "Ihre Ust-Nr." which refers to customer.
- All monetary values converted from comma to dot for numeric representation; decimal places preserved.

4) Final extracted values to populate schema
- GrandTotal.Amount -> 1526.49
- Invoice.Date -> "15.11.2023"
- Sender.VatId -> "ATU26011605"
- Vat.Rate -> 10.00
- Net.Amount -> 1387.72
- Vat.Amount -> 138.77
